description.value: Caffé Divano Port Moody is the founding location of a family-owned café group, opened in 2008 by Patrick and Lisa Beecroft in the Klahanie neighbourhood. The café sits a short walk from Rocky Point Park and is connected to the broader Port Moody trail network via a pedestrian overpass, making it a natural mid-ride stop for cyclists exploring the Tri-Cities. Local art covers the walls and a strong community ethos has kept it a neighbourhood anchor for nearly two decades.
